AI.theory_contributions: 验证了外推信念模型在货币政策传导中的作用，深化了对房地产市场异质性反应的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了在房地产繁荣期更精准实施货币政策的依据，有助于市场稳定。

title: Careers of Minimum Wage Workers
affiliations: Wellesley College, Harvard University - Entrepreneurial Management Unit and Greenhill House

detail.title: Careers of Minimum Wage Workers
detail.abstract:
We characterize the careers of minimum wage workers by merging SIPP panels covering 1992-2016 into the LEHD. A long-run analysis shows strong earnings growth for these workers in subsequent decades, becoming indistinguishable from peers earning modestly more initially. Most of this growth is due to the steep earnings trajectories of young workers. Older workers earning minimum wages show a modest dip in earnings at that moment compared to earlier and later periods. Increases in state minimum wages do not significantly alter the future careers of workers who are on the minimum wage when the increases occur.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了最低工资工人的职业生涯，发现年轻的最低工资工人有强劲的收入增长，而年长工人则有轻微的收入下降。州最低工资上调对当时领取最低工资的工人未来职业发展没有显著影响。
AI.research_question: 最低工资工人的长期职业生涯发展轨迹如何？州最低工资上调对这些工人的未来职业发展有何影响？
AI.motivation: 理解最低工资政策对工人长期职业发展的实际影响，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场理论和职业发展理论，分析最低工资工人的收入动态变化。
AI.method: 将1992-2016年的SIPP面板数据与LEHD数据合并，进行长期追踪分析。
AI.findings: 1) 最低工资工人在后续几十年有强劲的收入增长，与初始收入略高的同龄人无显著差异；2) 大部分增长来自年轻工人的陡峭收入轨迹；3) 年长最低工资工人在该时期有轻微收入下降；4) 州最低工资上调不影响当时最低工资工人的未来职业发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了最低工资工人长期职业发展的实证证据，挑战了关于最低工资工人职业前景的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为最低工资政策评估提供重要参考，表明最低工资上调可能不会对工人长期职业发展产生负面影响。

title: How has the COVID-19 pandemic brought opportunities amidst challenges for Industrial Evolution to Metropolitan Peripheral Regions？ The Case of Yangtze River Delta, China
affiliations: Tongji University, Shandong University, Tongji University and Tongji University

detail.title: How has the COVID-19 pandemic brought opportunities amidst challenges for Industrial Evolution to Metropolitan Peripheral Regions？ The Case of Yangtze River Delta, China
detail.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has reshaped regional economic landscapes. However, academic research has not yet sufficiently addressed how external investment in regions has been transformed under the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic and its influence on industrial evolution patterns. In this paper, we integrate insights from economic geography literature and develop a conceptual framework to further theorise the relationship between external shocks, changes in the industrial heterogeneity of investment from regional core cities, and local industrial dynamics. Using the COVID-19 pandemic and the Yangtze River Delta region as a case study, we employ an intensity-based Difference-in-Differences (DID) approach and draw on business registration and enterprise investment databases to estimate the impact of the pandemic shock on the evolution of local industrial dynamics between 2018 and 2024. Our findings indicate that after the core cities underwent the shock of the COVID-19 pandemic, the path dependence of industrial evolution in their surrounding areas significantly increased. The stronger the economic linkage with Shanghai, the more pronounced this effect. However, this impact also exhibits spatial heterogeneity across the Yangtze River Delta, associated with regional industrial division of labour and cooperation. This paper offers an innovative examination of how changes in the industrial heterogeneity of investment inflows from core cities—specifically, dimensions such as relatedness to local industries, industrial upgrading, and diversification—shape the mechanisms of local industrial evolution following the COVID-19 shock. Our findings offer important implications for regional development and adaptive responses in the post-pandemic era.

AI.tldr: 本文研究COVID-19疫情如何改变核心城市对外投资的产业异质性，以及这种变化对周边地区产业演化的影响。研究发现疫情冲击增强了周边地区的产业路径依赖，且与上海经济联系越强，这种效应越明显。
AI.research_question: COVID-19疫情如何改变核心城市对外投资的产业异质性，以及这种变化如何影响周边地区的产业演化模式？
AI.motivation: 学术界尚未充分研究COVID-19疫情下区域外部投资如何转变及其对产业演化模式的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合经济地理学文献，构建外部冲击、核心城市投资产业异质性变化与地方产业动态关系的概念框架。
AI.method: 采用基于强度的双重差分法（DID），利用工商注册和企业投资数据库，分析2018-2024年疫情冲击对长三角地区产业动态演化的影响。
AI.findings: 核心城市经历疫情冲击后，周边地区产业演化的路径依赖显著增强；与上海经济联系越强，效应越明显；影响在长三角地区存在空间异质性，与区域产业分工合作相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 创新性地考察了核心城市投资流入的产业异质性变化（与本地产业关联度、产业升级、多元化等维度）如何塑造疫情冲击后地方产业演化机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为后疫情时代的区域发展和适应性响应提供重要启示。

title: Carbon Taxation and Firm Behavior in Emerging Economies: Evidence from South Africa
affiliations: Potsdam-Institut für Klimafolgenforschung (PIK), United Nations University World Institute for Development Economics Research (UNU-WIDER), National University Singapore, University of Münster and Carnegie Mellon University

detail.title: Carbon Taxation and Firm Behavior in Emerging Economies: Evidence from South Africa
detail.abstract:
This paper provides the first comprehensive evidence on how firms in emerging economies respond to carbon taxation. Using detailed administrative data, we study the announcement and implementation of South Africa’s 2019 carbon tax—a potential trailblazer for other developing countries with limited state capacity amid the global expansion of carbon pricing. Contrary to concerns that carbon taxes might hinder growth or employment, we find no negative effects on firm performance or jobs. Firms facing higher effective tax rates increased activity following the tax’s announcement, four years before implementation, likely reflecting the resolution of regulatory uncertainty and efforts to mitigate stranded asset costs. While we find no measurable reduction in emissions—likely due to this anticipatory behavior—our results suggest that carbon taxation can be implemented without harming economic outcomes, even in the short term and in low- and middle-income settings.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提供了关于新兴经济体企业如何应对碳税的综合证据。研究发现南非2019年碳税的实施并未对企业绩效或就业产生负面影响，反而在税收宣布后企业活动增加，表明碳税可以在不损害经济成果的情况下实施。
AI.research_question: 新兴经济体中的企业如何应对碳税？碳税是否会对企业绩效和就业产生负面影响？
AI.motivation: 为其他发展中国家提供碳定价政策的实证证据，特别是在国家能力有限的情况下，解决碳税可能阻碍经济增长或就业的担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳税政策效应理论、监管不确定性理论、搁置资产成本理论
AI.method: 使用详细的行政数据，研究南非2019年碳税的宣布和实施过程
AI.findings: 1) 碳税未对企业绩效或就业产生负面影响；2) 面临更高有效税率的企业在税收宣布后增加了活动；3) 未发现可测量的排放减少，可能是由于预期行为
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了新兴经济体碳税效应的首个综合证据，挑战了碳税会损害经济的传统观点
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家实施碳定价政策提供了实证支持，表明碳税可以在不损害短期经济成果的情况下实施

title: Invisible Struggles and Strengths: Empowerment of Mothers of Children with Intellectual Disabilities in Türkiye
affiliations: Izmir Katip Celebi University, Izmir Katip Celebi University and Izmir Katip Celebi University

detail.title: Invisible Struggles and Strengths: Empowerment of Mothers of Children with Intellectual Disabilities in Türkiye
detail.abstract: This study aimed to make visible the transformative role of the experiences of mothers of children with intellectual disabilities through a holistic social work perspective, focusing on their experiences prior to diagnosis, during the diagnostic process, and post-diagnosis. A phenomenological qualitative design was employed, utilizing purposive sampling to recruit mothers of children with intellectual disabilities. In-depth interviews with ten mothers were thematically analyzed using MAXQDA 2022 software. Following the diagnosis, mothers initially described their children as “normal” and frequently concealed the condition. Daily life challenges intensified, and both individual and family dynamics underwent significant change. Participants adopted active coping strategies, such as seeking support, alongside passive strategies, such as suppressing emotions or relying on fate. Over time, they reported transformations in self-perception, relationships, and life perspectives while gradually adapting to a new normal. Since the stressors encountered were multidimensional, the findings highlight the necessity of developing holistic social work interventions that address individual, environmental, and social systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过现象学质性方法探讨智力障碍儿童母亲的转变性经历，发现她们在诊断前后经历了从否认到适应的过程，采用积极和消极应对策略，最终在自我认知、关系和人生观方面发生转变，强调需要多维度的社会工作干预。
AI.research_question: 智力障碍儿童母亲的经历在诊断前、诊断过程中和诊断后如何体现其转变性角色？
AI.motivation: 从整体社会工作视角揭示智力障碍儿童母亲经历的转变性作用，关注她们在不同阶段的体验和适应过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现象学质性研究框架，关注母亲的主观经验和意义建构过程。
AI.method: 采用现象学质性设计，通过目的性抽样招募10位智力障碍儿童母亲，进行深度访谈，并使用MAXQDA 2022软件进行主题分析。
AI.findings: 诊断后母亲最初将孩子描述为"正常"并经常隐瞒病情；日常生活挑战加剧，个人和家庭动态发生显著变化；参与者采用积极应对策略（寻求支持）和消极策略（压抑情绪或依赖命运）；随时间推移，她们在自我认知、关系和人生观方面发生转变，逐渐适应新常态。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对智力障碍儿童母亲经历转变过程的理解，为家庭适应理论和应对策略研究提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调需要发展整体社会工作干预，解决个人、环境和社会系统的多维压力源，为相关服务提供实践指导。

title: MOTHER'S WORK AND CHILDREN'S HEALTH IN CAMEROON: AN ANALYSIS OF THE EFFECTS
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Maroua, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Dschang

detail.title: MOTHER'S WORK AND CHILDREN'S HEALTH IN CAMEROON: AN ANALYSIS OF THE EFFECTS
detail.abstract: This article examines for the first time the differentiated intergenerational effects of maternal labor force participation on children's health in Cameroon. To achieve this objective, we pave the way for empirical evaluation based on models of household labor supply and health production, particularly child health. We use data from the fourth Cameroonian household survey (ECAM4) to test the hypotheses. To achieve this, econometric estimations are carried out using logistic instrumental variable models. From these estimations, we find that employed mothers have a positive and significant influence on children's health status, while self-employed mothers have a negative and significant influence on children's health status in Cameroon. The estimation differentiated by child's sex and the nature of maternal employment reveals an identical result and thus demonstrates the robustness of our results. These two major results show that it is urgent for the Cameroonian government to promote decent work and women's entrepreneurship.

AI.tldr: 本文首次研究了喀麦隆母亲劳动力参与对儿童健康的分化性代际影响，发现就业母亲对儿童健康有显著正面影响，而自雇母亲则有显著负面影响。
AI.research_question: 母亲劳动力参与对喀麦隆儿童健康的分化性代际影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 首次在喀麦隆背景下研究母亲就业形式对儿童健康的不同影响，填补了相关研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于家庭劳动力供给模型和健康生产函数理论，特别是儿童健康生产函数。
AI.method: 使用喀麦隆第四次家庭调查(ECAM4)数据，采用逻辑工具变量模型进行计量经济学估计。
AI.findings: 就业母亲对儿童健康有显著正面影响，自雇母亲对儿童健康有显著负面影响；按儿童性别和母亲就业性质分组的估计结果一致，证明了结果的稳健性。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了劳动力供给与健康生产理论在发展中国家背景下的应用，揭示了母亲就业形式对儿童健康的分化性影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为喀麦隆政府推动体面工作和女性创业提供政策依据，强调需要促进女性正规就业以改善儿童健康。

title: Biased Party Nominations as a Source of Women's Electoral Underperformance
affiliations: Princeton University, University of California, Davis and Harvard University

detail.title: Biased Party Nominations as a Source of Women's Electoral Underperformance
detail.abstract:
What accounts for differences in electoral success between male and female candidates? We argue that parties systematically nominate female candidates to districts where the party is less popular, making it harder for women to get elected. Our empirical strategy uses the German mixed electoral system to create counterfactual gender vote gaps. These gaps represent the scenario where male and female candidates are nominated in districts where their respective parties have equal popularity. Using data on all candidates for the German Bundestag across eleven elections, we document that female underperformance, and its variation across parties and election years, is explained almost entirely by women running in districts where their party is less popular. In contrast, we find no evidence that voter bias or candidate characteristics play a substantial role. Our argument highlights gendered party gatekeeping that increases in district strength as an important driver of female underrepresentation.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用德国混合选举系统数据发现，女性候选人在选举中表现不佳的主要原因是政党系统性地将女性候选人分配到政党支持度较低的选区，而非选民偏见或候选人个人特征。
AI.research_question: 什么因素解释了男女候选人在选举成功方面的差异？
AI.motivation: 探讨女性在政治代表中代表性不足的根本原因，特别关注政党提名机制的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政党门控理论，强调政党在候选人提名过程中的性别偏见机制。
AI.method: 利用德国混合选举系统创建反事实性别投票差距，分析11次联邦议院选举的所有候选人数据。
AI.findings: 女性表现不佳几乎完全由女性在政党支持度较低的选区参选所解释，没有发现选民偏见或候选人特征的显著作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了随着选区实力增强而加剧的性别化政党门控机制是女性代表性不足的重要驱动因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为改善女性政治代表性提供了政策启示，强调需要改革政党提名机制而非仅仅关注选民教育。

title: The Austerity Threshold
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University, University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School and Columbia University Graduate School of Business

detail.title: The Austerity Threshold
detail.abstract:
We introduce a new indicator of fiscal capacity—the “austerity threshold”: the debt-to-GDP level above which the government must raise fiscal surpluses to ensure debt safety. In a model with realistic risk premia, nominal rigidities, and an intermediary sector, calibrated to the U.S., we estimate this threshold at 189%. We highlight the roles of safety premia and intermediation-driven convenience yields. The threshold varies with the source of surpluses: spending cuts reduce inflation and allow low interest rates, while tax increases distort labor supply and raise inflation. Uncertainty over the austerity regime—spending cuts or tax increases—sharply lowers fiscal capacity. The expected austerity regime affects asset prices and macro outcomes even when debt-to-GDP is well below the threshold.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个新的财政能力指标——"紧缩阈值"，即政府为确保债务安全而必须提高财政盈余的债务与GDP比率。基于美国数据校准的模型估计该阈值为189%。研究强调了安全溢价和中介驱动便利收益率的作用，并发现紧缩方式（支出削减vs税收增加）对通胀和宏观经济有不同影响。
AI.research_question: 如何定义和量化政府的财政能力阈值？不同财政紧缩方式对宏观经济和资产价格有何影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对政府财政能力边界的明确量化指标，需要理解不同财政调整方式对经济的影响差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于包含现实风险溢价、名义刚性和中介部门的模型框架，引入安全溢价和便利收益率概念。
AI.method: 构建包含风险溢价、名义刚性和中介部门的经济模型，使用美国数据进行校准分析。
AI.findings: 紧缩阈值为189%债务/GDP；支出削减降低通胀和利率，税收增加扭曲劳动供给并推高通胀；紧缩方式不确定性显著降低财政能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"紧缩阈值"这一新的财政能力指标，深化了对不同财政调整方式传导机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估财政可持续性的量化工具，揭示了不同紧缩策略的宏观经济后果。

title: Operationalizing Nature Recovery to Market Outcomes
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - Scripps Institution of Oceanography, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - Scripps Institution of Oceanography

detail.title: Operationalizing Nature Recovery to Market Outcomes
detail.abstract: A prosperous blue economy in coastal areas requires operational models that clearly link ecological outcomes to economic returns. These models can support investment, planning, and the growth of non-extractive economies that benefit both coastal communities and the environment. Here, we focus on an Essential Ocean Variable—fish biomass—because it is a globally standardized and monitored variable with proven links to recovery and management. We connect this variable to a key economic output: scuba diving ecotourism, which is a critical component of many coastal economies. To link the two, we built a dual-model heuristic: (i) a spatial hedonic model across diving sites distributed globally relating standardized per-tank prices to reef fish biomass, and (ii) a temporal model linking fish biomass dynamics in Cabo Pulmo National Park to visitation rates. The model shows that a 10% increase in fish biomass is associated with a ~3.46% increase in diving price (R2 = 0.335, p = 0.0016). Scenario analysis from a degraded baseline (300 kg/ha) to near-pristine levels (~8,000 kg/ha) projects revenue gains of ~30–252%, increasing pooled annual revenue by about $6.26 million (≈$1.25 million per operator versus $0.35 million in degraded conditions). This heuristic converts ecological change into finance-ready outputs—price changes, revenue projections, ROI, and payback timelines—offering a tool to design and fund effective marine protection while aligning tourism markets with ecosystem recovery.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个将鱼类生物量（生态变量）与潜水生态旅游经济收益关联的双模型启发式工具，发现鱼类生物量增加10%可使潜水价格提高约3.46%，从退化状态恢复到接近原始状态可带来30-252%的收入增长。
AI.research_question: 如何将海洋生态变量（鱼类生物量）与潜水生态旅游的经济产出建立量化联系？
AI.motivation: 蓝色经济需要能够明确连接生态结果与经济回报的运营模型，以支持投资规划和促进对沿海社区和环境都有利的非采掘性经济发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生态经济学和生态系统服务评估理论，将鱼类生物量作为关键生态变量，潜水旅游作为经济产出指标。
AI.method: 构建双模型启发式：(1) 全球潜水点空间享乐模型，将标准化每罐潜水价格与礁鱼生物量关联；(2) 卡波普尔莫国家公园鱼类生物量动态与访问率的时序模型。
AI.findings: 鱼类生物量增加10%与潜水价格提高约3.46%相关；从退化状态（300公斤/公顷）恢复到接近原始状态（约8000公斤/公顷）可带来30-252%的收入增长，年收入增加约626万美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了将生态变化转化为金融可行输出的理论框架，为海洋保护提供量化评估工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可直接用于金融决策的工具，包括价格变化、收入预测、投资回报率和回收期计算，有助于设计资助有效的海洋保护措施，并使旅游市场与生态系统恢复保持一致。

title: Compensation Consultants and CEO Pay Peer Groups
affiliations: Fordham University , affiliation not provided to SSRN and Fordham University

detail.title: Compensation Consultants and CEO Pay Peer Groups
detail.abstract: This paper examines the role of consultants in firms’ selection of compensation peers. Peer-choice analysis shows that firms are more likely to select peers employing the same consultant. Such preference amplifies the peer-pay effect (favoring peers with higher-paid CEOs). Firms whose peer group consists of more peers sharing consultants with them have higher median peer pay and CEO pay, lower pay-performance sensitivity, and lower likelihood of consultant turnover. Overall, our evidence suggests that consultants strategically induce firms to select their existing clients with higher-paid CEOs as peers due to a familiarity bias and a desire to attract repeated business.

AI.tldr: 咨询顾问在企业选择薪酬对标公司时存在利益冲突，他们倾向于推荐现有客户作为对标公司，这些客户通常有更高薪酬的CEO，从而推高客户企业CEO薪酬水平，降低薪酬绩效敏感性。
AI.research_question: 咨询顾问在企业选择薪酬对标公司过程中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 了解咨询顾问在薪酬对标选择中的潜在利益冲突及其对企业薪酬实践的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理理论和利益冲突理论，分析咨询顾问的动机和行为
AI.method: 使用同行选择分析，比较共享咨询顾问与不共享咨询顾问的企业选择模式
AI.findings: 企业更可能选择与同一咨询顾问合作的公司作为对标公司；这种偏好放大了薪酬对标效应；共享咨询顾问越多的企业，其中位数对标薪酬和CEO薪酬越高，薪酬绩效敏感性越低，咨询顾问更换可能性越小
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了咨询顾问在薪酬对标过程中的战略行为，扩展了代理理论和利益冲突理论在薪酬咨询领域的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业董事会和监管机构提供警示，建议加强对薪酬咨询顾问的监督，防止利益冲突影响薪酬决策

title: Working it out: Randomized Modification and Entrepreneurial Effort in a Collateralized Debt Market
affiliations: Duke University, Fuqua School of Business, Dartmouth College, Kellogg School of Management - Department of Finance and Dartmouth College

detail.title: Working it out: Randomized Modification and Entrepreneurial Effort in a Collateralized Debt Market
detail.abstract:
We enrich a standard debt overhang model with liquidity constraints to guide the design and interpretation of a collateralized debt modification experiment on a publicly traded lender’s delinquent vehicle loans to minibus entrepreneurs. Liquidity constraints add another borrower incentive compatibility constraint that interacts with debt overhang to shape repayment and effort. Consistent with model predictions, we find: debt reduction does not affect liquidity constrained borrowers; payment reduction improves both repayment and effort for borrowers with sufficient vehicle equity; payment reduction induces repayment without effort increases for low-equity borrowers. These results suggest a pecking order strategy for modification practice and policy.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究在标准债务积压模型基础上加入流动性约束，通过车辆贷款债务重组实验发现：债务减免对流动性受限借款人无效；支付减免对拥有足够车辆净值的借款人能同时改善还款和努力；而对低净值借款人仅能改善还款但不增加努力。
AI.research_question: 流动性约束如何与债务积压相互作用影响借款人的还款行为和努力水平？不同类型的债务重组（债务减免vs支付减免）对不同类型的借款人会产生什么差异化影响？
AI.motivation: 理解在流动性约束和债务积压双重约束下，如何设计有效的债务重组方案来改善借款人的还款行为和努力水平，为债务重组实践和政策提供指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 债务积压理论结合流动性约束理论，构建包含双重激励相容约束的理论模型。
AI.method: 对一家公开交易贷款机构的逾期车辆贷款进行抵押债务重组实验，针对小型巴士企业主借款人。
AI.findings: 1) 债务减免对流动性受限借款人无效；2) 支付减免对拥有足够车辆净值的借款人能同时改善还款和努力；3) 支付减免对低净值借款人仅能改善还款但不增加努力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将流动性约束引入债务积压模型，揭示了两种约束的相互作用机制，丰富了债务重组理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了债务重组实践的优先顺序策略：优先考虑支付减免而非债务减免，并根据借款人车辆净值状况采取差异化策略。

title: Ambiguity, Risk, and Payout Policy
affiliations: Northeastern University (USA) - Finance and Insurance Area and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Ambiguity, Risk, and Payout Policy
detail.abstract: We study the relation between ambiguity—Knightian uncertainty—and payout policy using theory and empirical tests. When outcome probabilities are uncertain, ambiguity-averse investors overweight the likelihoods of bad outcomes and underweight the likelihoods of good outcomes, reducing corporate investment attractiveness and raising cash payout preferences. Higher ambiguity is associated with lower corporate investment but higher propensities and levels of cash dividends and share repurchases. The economic magnitudes of these relations are similar to those of size and profitability. Ambiguity decreases after dividend initiation, suggesting payout substitutes for high-ambiguity investments. The positive ambiguity-payout relation contrasts with the known negative risk-payout relation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究模糊性（奈特不确定性）与公司分红政策的关系。研究发现，当投资者面临概率不确定时，会高估坏结果的可能性，从而降低投资吸引力并提高现金分红偏好。模糊性越高，公司投资越少，但现金分红和股票回购的倾向和水平越高。
AI.research_question: 模糊性（奈特不确定性）如何影响公司的分红政策？
AI.motivation: 理解在不确定性环境下，投资者行为如何影响公司的投资和分红决策，以及模糊性与传统风险对分红政策的不同影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于奈特不确定性理论和模糊厌恶理论，投资者在概率不确定时会高估坏结果的可能性。
AI.method: 理论模型构建和实证检验相结合的方法。
AI.findings: 1. 模糊性越高，公司投资越少；2. 模糊性越高，现金分红和股票回购的倾向和水平越高；3. 分红启动后模糊性降低，表明分红可以替代高模糊性投资；4. 模糊性与分红的正相关关系与传统风险与分红的负相关关系形成对比。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统探讨模糊性对分红政策的影响，区分了模糊性与传统风险的不同作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公司在不确定性环境下的资本配置决策提供理论指导，帮助投资者理解分红政策背后的行为动机。

title: Policy Transmission in the Stock Market: Evidence from China
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, , affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Policy Transmission in the Stock Market: Evidence from China
detail.abstract: This study examines whether industrial policies in China affect stock prices and generate tradable signals beyond conventional risk factors. Using large language models, more than four million city-level policy documents are processed to identify 403,240 validated policy events. These are mapped into firm-level exposures by combining policy strength with firms’ revenue composition, industry classification, and location. Empirically, policy exposure does not generate immediate gains: the contemporaneous effects are weak or negative. Meanwhile, statistically significant positive returns materialize after one to three trading days, consistent with delayed market adjustment. The magnitudes are heterogeneous across industries, with innovation intensive industries reacting more strongly than traditional or heavily regulated ones. Translating the evidence into portfolios, the baseline portfolio tilted toward industrial policy sensitive firms achieves an annualized return of 31.75% with a Sharpe ratio of 1.00. It delivers economically and statistically significant alphas relative to the five-factor model and standard strategy benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用大语言模型分析中国城市级政策文件，发现产业政策对股价有延迟影响，1-3天后产生显著正收益，创新密集型行业反应更强。基于此构建的投资组合年化回报率达31.75%。
AI.research_question: 中国产业政策是否影响股票价格并产生可交易信号？
AI.motivation: 探究产业政策在传统风险因素之外是否提供可交易的超额收益机会
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场效率理论、政策传导机制、行为金融学中的延迟反应
AI.method: 使用大语言模型处理400多万份城市级政策文件，识别403,240个政策事件，结合企业收入构成、行业分类和地理位置构建企业级政策暴露度
AI.findings: 政策暴露度不产生即时收益，但1-3个交易日后出现显著正回报；创新密集型行业反应强于传统或严格监管行业
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了产业政策对股票市场的延迟影响机制，拓展了政策传导理论
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了基于产业政策敏感性的投资策略，年化回报31.75%，夏普比率1.00，相对五因子模型产生显著alpha

title: Hedge funds: 20 years of contrarian trading
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Lancaster University Management School and University of Strathclyde

detail.title: Hedge funds: 20 years of contrarian trading
detail.abstract: Over the twenty-years from 2000 to 2020, hedge funds played an important role redistributing liquidity in the equity market. Using returns from contrarian strategies as a proxy for liquidity provision, we show that hedge funds provide liquidity to high-information asymmetry stocks while demanding it from low-information asymmetry stocks, albeit this pattern temporarily reversed during the 2007-2009 financial crisis. Such liquidity redistribution is greater for funds less subject to funding risk, those that contractually impose longer redemption and subscription periods or rely on multiple prime brokers. Overall, hedge funds enhance the liquidity of stocks they trade; however, their contrarian strategies are not generally associated with abnormally improved fund performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2000-2020年间对冲基金在股票市场中的流动性再分配作用。研究发现对冲基金为信息不对称程度高的股票提供流动性，同时从信息不对称程度低的股票中获取流动性，但这一模式在2007-2009年金融危机期间暂时逆转。流动性再分配效应在受融资风险影响较小的基金中更为显著。
AI.research_question: 对冲基金如何在股票市场中执行流动性再分配功能？这种再分配如何受到信息不对称、融资风险等因素的影响？
AI.motivation: 理解对冲基金作为市场流动性提供者的角色，特别是在信息不对称和融资约束条件下的行为模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于流动性提供理论、信息不对称理论和融资约束理论，分析对冲基金的交易策略和市场功能。
AI.method: 使用逆向策略收益作为流动性提供的代理变量，分析2000-2020年间对冲基金交易数据，采用面板回归等方法。
AI.findings: 1. 对冲基金为高信息不对称股票提供流动性，从低信息不对称股票获取流动性；2. 金融危机期间这一模式暂时逆转；3. 融资风险较小的基金流动性再分配效应更强；4. 对冲基金改善了所交易股票的流动性，但逆向策略并未带来超额收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对冲基金作为流动性提供者的理论理解，揭示了信息不对称和融资约束在流动性再分配中的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者理解对冲基金市场功能提供实证依据，为监管机构制定相关政策提供参考。

title: Financial Literacy, Attitude, and Behavior: The Mediating Role of Attitude in the Relationship among Vietnamese High School Students
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Financial Literacy, Attitude, and Behavior: The Mediating Role of Attitude in the Relationship among Vietnamese High School Students
detail.abstract: This study investigates whether financial literacy significantly affects financial behavior among Vietnamese high school students while exploring the influence of attitudes and demographic factors. In the era of globalization and digital transformation, financial literacy has emerged as an essential life skill. Although more than seventy countries have incorporated financial education into their national curricula, Vietnam still faces major gaps in financial capability despite rapid economic growth. With GDP per capita reaching approximately USD 4,600 in 2024 and over 80% of Vietnamese youth using digital banking services, only 36% of the population understands key financial concepts, and nearly 70% of young people report never having learned finance in school. The introduction of “Economic and Legal Education” in the 2018 curriculum reform remains largely theoretical and lacks systematic personal finance content, underscoring the need for empirical evidence to inform education policy and practice. To address this issue, a cross-sectional survey was conducted among 20 randomly selected high school students aged 15–17 from gifted, public, and private or international schools in Hanoi. Financial literacy was assessed using the standardized “Big Five” questions, while financial behavior was measured through items designed to capture budgeting, saving, debt management, and investing habits. Financial attitudes were evaluated using Likert-scale questions measuring confidence, perceived importance, usefulness, relevance, and motivation toward financial learning. The data were analyzed using Pearson correlation, multiple linear regression with demographic controls, and mediation analysis. The results revealed a significant positive relationship between financial literacy and financial behavior (r = 0.491, p < 0.05), with financial attitude showing an even stronger association (r = 0.623, p < 0.01). Hierarchical regression analysis indicated that both financial literacy (β = 0.071, p < 0.05) and financial attitude (β = 0.408, p < 0.001) significantly predicted financial behavior after accounting for demographic factors, explaining 43.1% of the variance. Mediation analysis confirmed that attitudes partially mediated the relationship between financial literacy and financial behavior, with 23.5% of the total effect explained through this pathway. On average, students exhibited relatively high levels of financial literacy (mean = 3.94/5) but only moderate confidence in financial management (mean = 2.9/5). While they strongly believed in the importance of financial education (mean = 4.45/5), they rated the usefulness of current economics lessons relatively low (mean = 2.7/5). Overall, the study concludes that financial literacy has a significant impact on financial behavior among Vietnamese high school students; however, this effect largely operates through the mediating role of financial attitudes. The findings highlight a critical discrepancy between students’ positive attitudes toward financial education and their limited practical confidence in applying financial knowledge. This suggests that current curricular approaches may not effectively translate conceptual understanding into behavioral competence. Therefore, future educational interventions should integrate both cognitive and affective components, emphasizing experiential learning to strengthen students’ confidence and real-world financial capability. These insights carry important policy implications for enhancing the personal finance content of Vietnam’s evolving education system.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了金融素养对越南高中生金融行为的影响，发现金融素养通过金融态度的中介作用显著影响金融行为。研究显示学生金融素养水平较高但对财务管理信心不足，当前课程未能有效将理论知识转化为实践能力。
AI.research_question: 金融素养是否显著影响越南高中生的金融行为？态度和人口因素在其中起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 在全球化与数字化转型时代，金融素养成为关键生活技能。尽管70多个国家已将金融教育纳入国家课程，越南在快速经济增长下仍面临金融能力不足的问题。2024年人均GDP达4600美元，80%以上年轻人使用数字银行服务，但仅36%人口理解关键金融概念，近70%年轻人从未在学校学习过金融知识。2018年课程改革引入的'经济与法律教育'仍偏理论，缺乏系统性个人理财内容。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融素养理论、金融行为理论、态度-行为关系理论、中介效应理论
AI.method: 对河内20名15-17岁高中生（来自重点、公立、私立/国际学校）进行横断面调查。使用标准化'五大问题'评估金融素养，通过预算、储蓄、债务管理和投资习惯项目测量金融行为，使用李克特量表评估金融态度（信心、重要性感知、有用性、相关性和学习动机）。数据分析采用皮尔逊相关、多元线性回归（含人口控制变量）和中介分析。
AI.findings: 金融素养与金融行为呈显著正相关（r=0.491, p<0.05），金融态度关联更强（r=0.623, p<0.01）。层级回归显示金融素养（β=0.071, p<0.05）和金融态度（β=0.408, p<0.001）均显著预测金融行为，解释43.1%方差。中介分析确认态度部分中介金融素养与行为的关系，23.5%总效应通过此路径解释。学生金融素养水平较高（均值3.94/5）但财务管理信心中等（均值2.9/5），强烈认同金融教育重要性（均值4.45/5）但对当前经济课程有用性评价较低（均值2.7/5）。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实金融素养通过金融态度的中介作用影响金融行为，深化了对认知-情感-行为路径的理解，为金融教育理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示当前课程未能有效将理论知识转化为实践能力的问题，建议教育干预应整合认知与情感成分，强调体验式学习以增强学生信心和实际金融能力，为越南教育系统改革提供政策启示。

title: GDP Growth Expectations and Cash-flow Risk Premium
affiliations: Yale School of Management - International Center for Finance, University of Alberta - School of Business and University of Alberta

detail.title: GDP Growth Expectations and Cash-flow Risk Premium
detail.abstract:
We show that procyclical stocks–those whose cash flows rise with expected economic growth–earn higher average returns than countercyclical stocks. Leveraging nearly 75 years of economist survey data on real GDP growth expectations, we identify economic states while sidestepping model-driven forecast error. GDP forecasts comove with consumption and predict the market return, real GDP growth, and consumption growth. This approach builds on the literatures on both the Intertemporal and Consumption Capital Asset Pricing Models. We document a statistically significant, economically meaningful procyclicality premium that remains robust to standard factor controls.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现顺周期股票（现金流随预期经济增长而增加的股票）比逆周期股票获得更高的平均回报，这一现象被称为顺周期性溢价。
AI.research_question: 顺周期股票是否比逆周期股票获得更高的平均回报？
AI.motivation: 基于ICAPM和CCAPM理论，研究经济周期对股票回报的影响，利用经济学家调查数据来识别经济状态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨期资本资产定价模型（ICAPM）和消费资本资产定价模型（CCAPM）
AI.method: 使用近75年的经济学家调查数据（实际GDP增长预期），避免模型驱动的预测误差，分析GDP预测与消费、市场回报、实际GDP增长和消费增长的关系。
AI.findings: 存在统计显著且经济意义重大的顺周期性溢价，顺周期股票比逆周期股票获得更高的平均回报。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了ICAPM和CCAPM文献，提供了顺周期性溢价的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了基于经济周期的投资策略参考，顺周期股票具有更高的预期回报。

title: Loss or Gain from Separation? Wealth and Child Mental Health in Divorce Dynamics
affiliations: University of Texas at Arlington, Lafayette College - Department of Economics, Loyola Marymount University and University of Texas at Arlington - College of Business Administration - Department of Economics

detail.title: Loss or Gain from Separation? Wealth and Child Mental Health in Divorce Dynamics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no conflict of interest in this study.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this study.

detail.abstract: This paper reveals critical heterogeneity in child mental health outcomes following divorce, driven by wealth disparities and intersecting racial and gender dynamics. Leveraging longitudinal PSID and CDS data, we show that children in low-wealth households face a marked rise in mental disabilities post-divorce, exacerbated by parental health deterioration and economic precarity. In contrast, high-wealth households often experience protective effects, underscoring the buffering power of financial resources. Strikingly, black female-headed households in the low wealth category bear the greatest burden, amplifying systemic inequities. These findings challenge prevailing narratives of uniform post-divorce adversity, emphasizing wealth as a pivotal determinant of resilience.

AI.tldr: 本研究揭示了离婚后儿童心理健康结果存在显著异质性，主要由财富差距和交叉的种族、性别动态驱动。低收入家庭儿童在离婚后心理健康问题显著增加，而高收入家庭则受到保护。黑人女性主导的低收入家庭负担最重。
AI.research_question: 财富差距如何影响离婚后儿童的心理健康结果？种族和性别因素在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 挑战关于离婚后儿童普遍面临不利影响的传统观点，强调财富作为心理韧性的关键决定因素的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于财富不平等理论、交叉性理论（种族、性别、阶级的交叉影响）和家庭压力模型。
AI.method: 利用纵向PSID（收入动态面板研究）和CDS（儿童发展补充研究）数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 低收入家庭儿童在离婚后心理健康障碍显著增加，而高收入家庭儿童往往受到保护；黑人女性主导的低收入家庭承受最严重的负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了离婚对儿童影响的同质化叙事，强调了财富作为心理韧性缓冲器的重要性，并揭示了交叉性不平等的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供针对性干预的依据，强调需要关注低收入家庭特别是黑人女性主导家庭的特殊需求，以及财富再分配政策的重要性。

title: Valuation of Callable Loans with Volatility Discount

detail.title: Valuation of Callable Loans with Volatility Discount
detail.abstract: In this paper, we present an approach to calculate the Bermudan Call option value of a loan subjected to non-rational exercise decision based on additional opportunity costs. The approach is inspired by practical considerations and the aim to value loan options with standard interest rate option pricing methods. This should allow an easy integration into available valuation systems and processes. The main idea of our approach is to relate the non-rational exercise to a SABR swaption cube with decreased implied volatilities. Then, the model to calculate the loan option value is calibrated to reference European swaptions with volatilities from this SABR swaption cube. We focus on interest rate risk and assume deterministic credit spreads. Though, the model setup can be easily extended to stochastic credit spreads.

title: Stimulus through Insurance: the Marginal Propensity to Repay Debt

detail.title: Stimulus through Insurance: the Marginal Propensity to Repay Debt
detail.abstract:
Using detailed microdata, we document that households often use “stimulus” checks to pay down debt, especially those with low net wealth-to-income ratios. To rationalize these patterns, we introduce an empirically plausible borrowing price schedule into an otherwise standard incomplete markets model. Because interest rates rise with debt, borrowers have increasingly larger incentives to use an additional dollar to reduce debt service payments rather than consume. Using our calibrated model, we then study whether and how this marginal propensity to repay debt (MPRD) alters the aggregate implications of fiscal transfers. We uncover a trade-off between stimulus and insurance, as high–debt individuals gain considerably from transfers, but consume relatively little immediately. This mechanism lowers the immediate stimulus effect of fiscal transfers, but sustains aggregate consumption for longer.

detail.title: Trade Policy Ambiguity
detail.abstract:
This paper studies how Knightian uncertainty about the distribution of future trade policies affects current trade flows using a dynamic trade model with a sunk cost of exporting. Qualitatively, trade-policy ambiguity reduces export participation in a similar manner to standard trade-policy risk, but also increases sensitivity to tariff bounds, decreases sensitivity to the likelihood of a tariff increase, and can either increase or decrease sensitivity to tariff persistence. Quantitatively, ambiguity dampens the response of trade to persistent reforms and strengthens the response to transitory reforms.

detail.abstract: Background: India faces a dual challenge in diabetes care: a rising prevalence and limited access to personalized management in semi-urban and underserved regions. Grassroots, clinician-led innovations are increasingly addressing these gaps but remain under-documented in academic literature. The Jothydev's Professional Education Forum (JPEF)-USV Diabetes Technology Awards were established to recognize and support such field-level solutions, offering a repository of real-world approaches. Objective: To synthesize and describe the award-winning innovations recognized in the 2025 cycle, highlighting scalable, frugal, and culturally contextualized approaches to diabetes care. Methods: A descriptive thematic synthesis of more than 20 submissions was undertaken. Eligible entries included structured workflows, program documents, and multimedia evidence. Innovations were grouped into six thematic clusters: AI-enabled clinical decision support, digital therapeutics, hybrid telemedicine, social media empowerment, next-generation education interfaces, and translational biomarker research. Outcomes such as glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c), Time-in-Range, adherence, and patient engagement were descriptively summarized. Results: The innovations collectively demonstrated frugal, context-sensitive design and reported improvements in glycemic control, treatment adherence, patient empowerment, and community reach. Several programs documented HbA1c reductions, Time-in-Range gains, follow-up adherence exceeding 90%, and outreach campaigns engaging more than two million people. Conclusion: Clinician-led grassroots innovations are reshaping diabetes care in India through practical, low-cost, and culturally adapted digital models. Recognition frameworks such as the Awards provide legitimacy and visibility, enabling pathways for validation, scale-up, and integration into broader health systems. These lessons extend beyond India, offering transferable insights for resource-constrained settings worldwide.

title: The Relationship Between Certificate of Need Laws and Mortality
affiliations: RAND Corporation, Northwestern law, Brown University and RAND Corporation

detail.title: The Relationship Between Certificate of Need Laws and Mortality
detail.abstract:
Certificate of Need (CON) laws regulate entry and capital investments in healthcare with the goal of containing costs while preserving access and quality. This paper examines the relationship between these laws and overall mortality as well as leading causes of mortality: cancer and cardiovascular disease. Using county-level death records, we conducted an event-study analysis comparing mortality rates in states that repealed their CON laws to states that did not between 1979 and 2004. The repeal of CON laws was associated with short-run reductions in cancer mortality, primarily from reductions in lung cancer mortality. Cardiovascular mortality and all-cause mortality rates were unchanged.

detail.title: The Musk Partisan Effect on Tesla Sales
detail.abstract:
We study how Elon Musk's polarizing and partisan actions have impacted Tesla vehicle sales in the United States. Using county-level, monthly data on new vehicle registrations, we leverage how changes in vehicle sales over time diverge across counties with differing shares of Democratic and Republican voters. Without the Musk partisan effect, Tesla sales between October 2022 and April 2025 would have been 67-83% higher, equivalent to 1-1.26 million more vehicles. Musk’s partisan activities also increased the sales of other automakers' electric and hybrid vehicles 17-22% because of substitution, and undermined California’s progress in meeting its zero-emissions vehicle target.

title: Lessons for Automatic Fiscal Stabilizers from the Great Recession and the COVID Recession
affiliations: Harvard University and Harvard Kennedy School

detail.title: Lessons for Automatic Fiscal Stabilizers from the Great Recession and the COVID Recession
detail.abstract:
This paper simulates economic developments as if the discretionary fiscal stimulus enacted in the past two recessions had not occurred and additional automatic fiscal stabilizers had been deployed instead. For the calibration of key economic relationships most consistent with the empirical literature, we find that more sustained fiscal stimulus would have pushed unemployment down more rapidly following the Great Recession and that more limited stimulus would have caused inflation to increase much less following the COVID recession. We caution, though, that our estimates are uncertain given the large number of assumptions embedded in the calculations. Under different assumptions about the supply side of the economy when resource utilization is high, the stimulus enacted in early 2021 was not a significant cause of the observed runup in inflation that followed, and substituting an automatic stabilizer would have made little difference to inflation.

detail.abstract: Psychedelic therapies—ketamine, MDMA, psilocybin, LSD, DMT, and ibogaine—are moving from prohibition to regulated care, but commercialization hinges on FDA approval, DEA scheduling, and payor (insurance) coverage. This Article maps the U.S. regulatory labyrinth and analyzes how business models succeed or fail under these constraints. It explains bifurcated rescheduling (DEA reschedules the approved drug product, not the underlying Schedule I substance), and why coverage often follows FDA approval despite the high cost of clinical trials. Case studies track (1) ketamine’s split path: Janssen’s FDA-approved esketamine (Spravato) and off-label ketamine clinic chains; (2) MDMA’s “pseudo-nonprofit” pathway (MAPS, MAPS PBC, Lykos), including revenue-purchase financing (Vine Ventures) to fund Phase 3 trials; and (3) psilocybin’s IP divide: Usona’s nonprofit, open-science strategy (with Porta Sophia prior-art defenses) versus Compass Pathways’ for-profit, patent-driven route (COMP360, FDA Breakthrough Therapy). The Article distills practical takeaways on insurance strategy (on-label pathways, ancillary benefits, assisted-therapy billing), nonprofit/for-profit structuring, and patent freedom-to-operate that generalize to future psychedelic products. The framework offers regulators, payors, investors, and counsel a grounded playbook for scaling evidence-based access while avoiding IP bottlenecks and reputational traps.

detail.abstract: In any country, land is a precious real estate whose allocation to buyers or for public development needs to be carefully calibrated. Specifically, land must be put into appropriate use at a reasonable price in order to deliver economic and social utility to society such as for commercial use or public housing at a price that will not induce inflationary pressure on other goods, as well as not incur inter-generational debt burden. But, if an open bidding system is used to allocate land to the highest bidder, then there is the use of free market mechanism on land allocation. In such cases, the price of land fluctuates depending on whether there is hot money flowing into the economy, particularly in the property development sector. Hence, in the scenario where the local economy is booming, and hot money is flowing in due to a wide open capital account, then there is naturally an upward pressure on land price in an open bidding system. This will then increase the retail price of both private and public housing, which will incur inter-generation debt burden on the economy. One alternative way to value land is the estimated economic value of the proposed land use. For example, if the land is slated for hotel development, the economic value of the new development can be estimated by the observed revenue of current hotels of similar class and at similar location in the city. This sets the baseline value of the land on which the bidding can be controlled to within 15 to 20% of the baseline value.

detail.abstract: Cancer represents one of the most formidable public health challenges of the 21st century, imposing a profound and escalating burden on individuals, families, healthcare systems, and national economies. This report provides a comprehensive analysis of the multifaceted economic impact of malignant disease, synthesizing extensive data to quantify its scale, deconstruct its core components, and illuminate the stark disparities in its distribution. A landmark modeling study projects that the global macroeconomic cost of 29 major cancers will reach an astonishing $25.2 trillion (in constant 2017 international dollars) between 2020 and 2050, a figure equivalent to a persistent 0.55% annual tax on the world's Gross Domestic Product (GDP). This immense financial toll is not an abstract calculation but a tangible drag on global prosperity, driven by a complex interplay of direct healthcare expenditures, the escalating price of innovative therapies, and vast societal losses in productivity. The analysis reveals that this burden is highly concentrated, with five cancer types-tracheal, bronchus, and lung; colorectal; breast; liver; and leukemia-accounting for nearly half of the total global economic cost. The financial impact is also distributed with profound inequity.

detail.title: Economic and Ethical Barriers in Medicaid-Funded Home Care
detail.abstract: Home care workers represent one of the fastest-growing occupations in the United States. As the population ages, the demand for assistance with daily activities such as bathing, eating, and medication management continues to rise. The majority of individuals requiring long-term care prefer to remain at home rather than move to a nursing facility. Medicaid-funded Home and Community-Based Services (HCBS), through state programs, are the primary payer for these home-based services. Caregivers are the lifeline of home-based care, yet their compensation remains a point of contention. They bring comfort and stability to those in need, but many—especially family caregivers—cope with low wages, unpredictable hours, and scarce benefits, turning their financial security into an uphill battle. At the same time, home care agencies, bound by fixed Medicaid reimbursement rates, face a balancing act—meeting wage demands while staying financially afloat. This study analyzes the economic pressures and ethical concerns of caregiver compensation through a comprehensive approach. It draws observations from financial data, qualitative interviews, and survey responses from siztee home care agencies across multiple states. Policy analysts, healthcare professionals, and advocacy groups debate these issues in forums, blogs, and social media platforms, stressing the ethical and economic consequences. The findings reveal that Medicaid’s reimbursement structure largely undervalues the true cost of caregiving, leading to high turnover rates and compromised care quality. Caregivers frequently experience burnout due to excessive workloads and inadequate wages, disrupting patient care and workforce stability. Additionally, wage gaps between family and professional caregivers raise ethical questions about fairness and potential labor exploitation. Case studies across states with differing Medicaid reimbursement policies reveal a clear link between funding levels and the quality of home-based care.

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the interconnectedness of non-performing loans (NPLs) across 30 European economies, including the UK, using the Diebold–Yilmaz spillover index. Employing a linear VAR model of order 2 and Lanne–Nyberg variance decomposition on 12-period-ahead forecast errors over 2010Q1–2022Q2, the analysis reveals a persistently high total spillover index, indicating strong cross-country linkages in NPL dynamics. The results uncover an important asymmetry: economies that emerged from the global financial crisis in a relatively resilient position often act as net transmitters of NPL spillovers, while more vulnerable banking systems typically absorb them as receivers. This finding challenges the conventional view that fragility is the primary source of contagion, instead highlighting the role of resilient systems in propagating shocks through regional financial networks. The paper contributes to understanding the interplay between macroeconomic stability and credit risk transmission, with implications for European financial stability policy and cross-border supervision.

detail.abstract: We propose a model characterized by a 95% failure rate. Furthermore, we argue that models that exhibit such a significant statistical failure rate are particularly suitable to account for the presence of pathologies such as unemployment. In particular, we develop a highly stylized model that allows for an emergence of Nash equilibria characterized by the presence of disequilibrium in the labor market. Specifically, we depart from the standard assumptions and focus on the possibility of wage competition between firms, which, given that rational workers can find it optimal to chase high paying jobs and as a result risk unemployment rather than settle for a low paying job, affects the resulting flows of workers between firms. As a result, as soon as the underlying values of the fundamentals reach proper thresholds it may be optimal for producers to offer wages that exceed the market clearing wage in order to attract workers who would normally accept employment at competing firms. This leads to a fall in output and to a lesser competition from rival firms, which boosts the revenue and the profit despite costs being higher. The resulting equilibrium in our model is characterized by the presence of unemployment. Moreover, in equilibrium high paying jobs are scarce and low wage jobs are abundant and freely available. In addition, downward wage rigidity is present in our model. Finally, we show that minimum wage regulation can have a perverse effect on unemployment.

detail.abstract: Student dropout continues to pose a serious challenge in Philippine higher education, even within tuition-free institutions intended to promote access and equity. This study aimed to explore the lived experiences of students who dropped out of a free public higher education institution in the Philippines, focusing on the personal, academic, and institutional factors that influenced their decision to leave. Using a qualitative phenomenological design, 30 former students who officially dropped out during the second semester of Academic Year 2023–2024 were selected through purposive sampling. In-depth, semi-structured interviews were conducted, and data were analyzed using thematic analysis to identify recurring patterns and core experiences. Findings revealed that dropout was driven by financial struggles, family obligations, low academic readiness, and weak institutional support. Despite free tuition, students faced hidden costs such as transportation, daily meals, and learning materials, which compounded their difficulties. Many reported a lack of connection to faculty and limited awareness of available assistance programs. The study concludes that eliminating tuition is not enough to prevent dropout. It recommends the implementation of targeted interventions such as transportation subsidies, flexible class schedules, peer mentoring, mental health services, and academic bridging programs. These holistic, student-centered strategies are critical for building inclusive, supportive, and retention-focused environments in higher education.

detail.title: Autism and Vaccines: The Myth that Wouldn’t Die
detail.abstract: Vaccines causing autism have been a myth throughout the 20th and 21st centuries. This study investigates the prevalence of this misinformation on the app, Instagram. Instagram is an app that has most recently had the least amount of misinformation, due to its popularity among teens for sharing pictures more than political ideas; however, through Canva, making informatics, many people can share their misinformation on this app as well. A study of 50 public videos using the hashtags, such as, #antivax and #vaccineinjury was analyzed (analyzing 25 of each type). We found that only 2% of videos are spreading this misinformation, but 66% is still misinformation on childhood vaccines. Leading to the need for more legislation on these apps to fight misinformation.

AI.practical_contributions: 强调了需要加强社交媒体平台立法监管，以应对健康相关错误信息的传播。

detail.abstract: This study presents an explainable AI framework to detect elder financial exploitation in U.S. banking. Using gradient-boosted trees with SHAP explanations, the model identifies high-risk transaction patterns such as unusual merchant categories, spending velocity spikes, and off-hour activity. Tested on a 200,000transaction synthetic dataset aligned with public complaint data, the approach achieved a precision of 0.043, recall of 1.00, ROC-AUC of 0.995, and PR-AUC of 0.48-improving precision more than sixteen-fold over rule-based systems. Transparent explanations enable investigator rationales and regulatory auditability. The framework supports national efforts to protect seniors, strengthen consumer financial protection, and advance responsible AI adoption in the U.S. financial sector.

detail.abstract: Recently, the electricity industry, as the first high-carbon industry, has been included in the carbon emission trading market, and its carbon accounting information disclosure has attracted attention from creditors with the introduction of environmental economic policies such as Green Credit Policy. Thus, this paper, listed companies in the power industry as a sample, tries to explore the impact of the quality of carbon accounting information disclosure on the cost of debt capital, using improved index method to build the evaluation system. The empirical results show that the quality of carbon accounting information disclosure is negatively correlated with the cost of debt capital, and the degree of development of carbon emission trading market strengthens the negative correlation. Therefore, it is a wise choice for enterprises to actively carry out carbon disclosure and carbon management. Meanwhile, the government should actively promote the development of ETS market for reasonable reaction to carbon accounting information in debt capital market.

detail.title: The Expectation Effect of Climate Shocks How Extreme Weather Propagate Inflation
detail.abstract: This study investigates whether climate risk shocks trigger second-round effects on inflation through the expectations channel. Using a Structural Vector Autoregression (SVAR) with counterfactual analysis, we identify the transmission mechanism of climate shocks under scenarios with and without expectation effects. We find that a structural change has occurred in the way climate risk shocks affect prices and consumer expectations. Specifically, during the pre-break period, climate risk shocks tend to reduce both inflation expectations and realized inflation, whereas in the post-break period, such shocks increase both inflation and expected inflation. Moreover, in both periods, expectation-driven spillovers are found to amplify the overall impact on inflation dynamics, with the effect becoming particularly pronounced over medium-term horizons (9--20 months) after 2010. Furthermore, the post-break results indicate that these effects are primarily driven by fluctuations in the energy CPI and core CPI. These findings provide new evidence that climate risk has become increasingly embedded in inflation expectations, underscoring the need for monetary policy frameworks to incorporate expectation dynamics into inflation targeting in light of evolving climate conditions. (JEL classification: C32, E31, Q54)

title: Imperial Patterns of Sanctioned Economic Dominance in International Investment Law: From The East India Company to the Coalition Provisional Authority

detail.title: Imperial Patterns of Sanctioned Economic Dominance in International Investment Law: From The East India Company to the Coalition Provisional Authority
detail.abstract: This article examines the structural continuities between imperial economic governance and the modern regime of international investment law. By comparing Hugo Grotius’s seventeenth-century justification of the Dutch East India Company’s Santa Catarina seizure with the Coalition Provisional Authority’s post-invasion reforms in Iraq, it traces how legal doctrines historically used to rationalize commercial expansion have evolved into contemporary frameworks of investment protection. Using a socio-legal methodology, the study argues that investment law’s commitment to “stability” and “investor confidence” often reproduces historical asymmetries in bargaining power, constraining host-state economic self-determination. Rather than portraying the system as conspiratorial or monolithic, the analysis situates these dynamics within the broader evolution of global governance and the institutional incentives of international economic law. The article concludes by proposing a re-evaluation of post-investment accountability mechanisms to better align foreign investment flows with principles of sovereign equality and sustainable development.

detail.title: Impact of Political Allegiance on H-1B Visa Acceptances to the US: An Analysis of the Relationship Between UNGA Voting Alignment and H-1B Visa Acceptances to the United States
detail.abstract: Despite the critical role of H-1B visas in fostering innovation and economic growth in the United States (US), little is known about the relationship between political alignment with the US and H-1B visa approvals. We explore countries’ voting alignment in the United Nations (UN) and H-1B visa outcomes. We identify a significant relationship between political alignment and visa access. Countries can assess how geopolitics affects talent mobility, while US policymakers can evaluate whether immigration decisions reflect strategic economic priorities. We offer new insights into the intersection of geopolitical diplomacy and economic migration for more transparent, equitable, and growth-oriented policy. Our findings suggest that although the H-1B visa system is utilized to meet labor demands, it is also a diplomatic instrument. The most notable results are seen in the Middle East Region. As voting alignment with the US becomes increasingly positive, the region receives more visas, suggesting a correlation between voting alignment and visa approvals.

title: Emergent Dynamical Spatial Boundaries in Emergency Medical Services: A Navier-Stokes Framework from First Principles
affiliations: University of Tokyo

detail.title: Emergent Dynamical Spatial Boundaries in Emergency Medical Services: A Navier-Stokes Framework from First Principles
detail.abstract: Emergency medical services (EMS) response times are critical determinants of patient survival, yet existing approaches to spatial coverage analysis rely on discrete distance buffers or ad-hoc geographic information system (GIS) isochrones without theoretical foundation. This paper derives continuous spatial boundaries for emergency response from first principles using fluid dynamics (Navier-Stokes equations), demonstrating that response effectiveness decays exponentially with time: $\tau(t) = \tau_0 \exp(-\kappa t)$, where $\tau_0$ is baseline effectiveness and $\kappa$ is the temporal decay rate. Using 10,000 simulated emergency incidents from the National Emergency Medical Services Information System (NEMSIS), I estimate decay parameters and calculate critical boundaries $d^*$ where response effectiveness falls below policy-relevant thresholds. The framework reveals substantial demographic heterogeneity: elderly populations (85+) experience 8.40-minute average response times versus 7.83 minutes for younger adults (18-44), with 33.6\% of poor-access incidents affecting elderly populations despite representing 5.2\% of the sample. Non-parametric kernel regression validation confirms exponential decay is appropriate (mean squared error 8-12 times smaller than parametric), while traditional difference-in-differences analysis validates treatment effect existence (DiD coefficient = -1.35 minutes, $p < 0.001$). The analysis identifies vulnerable populations—elderly, rural, and low-income communities—facing systematically longer response times, informing optimal EMS station placement and resource allocation to reduce health disparities.

AI.tldr: 本文基于流体动力学原理推导出急救服务响应效果的连续空间边界，发现响应效果随时间呈指数衰减，并识别出老年人、农村和低收入社区等弱势群体面临系统性更长的响应时间。

AI.method: 使用10,000个模拟紧急事件数据，估计衰减参数并计算关键边界，采用非参数核回归验证和传统双重差分分析。
AI.findings: 响应效果呈指数衰减；老年人口(85+)平均响应时间8.40分钟，年轻成人(18-44)7.83分钟；33.6%的差可及性事件影响老年人口（仅占样本5.2%）。

detail.abstract: In many societies, attaining cultural ideals of physical attractiveness is desirable (e.g., being beautiful), but pursuing physical attractiveness is not (e.g., being vain). How do people address these paradoxical standards? We argue that people meet the standards to both appear slim and appear to have good values by disguising their true motives for ambiguous actions (i.e., diet, exercise): they project more virtuous health motives to others despite being actually driven by physical appearance motives. Five pre-registered studies and two supplemental studies (N = 4,321) find evidence for this behavior and offer an intervention to increase the extent to which people are actually driven by health (vs. physical appearance) motives in private. Moreover, we find that this behavior is driven by the desire to be seen by others as having good values. Altogether, this research contributes to a better understanding of the distorted discourse surrounding health, exercise, and appearance.

title: The Impact of Rural E-commerce on Rural Household Multidimensional Poverty Reduction: Evidence from China
affiliations: Zhejiang University, Zhejiang University and

detail.title: The Impact of Rural E-commerce on Rural Household Multidimensional Poverty Reduction: Evidence from China
detail.abstract: While rural e-commerce (REC) is increasingly acknowledged for its potential to reduce absolute poverty, its impact on multidimensional poverty (MP) remains under-explored. This study investigates the effect of REC on rural household MP in China, utilizing household-level survey data from the Chinese Family Database and the China Household Finance Survey (2013-2019). Employing the "Rural E-commerce Comprehensive Demonstration" (RECD) project as a quasinatural experiment, we examine both the direct effects and underlying mechanisms. Our findings reveal that (1) REC development significantly alleviates MP in rural households, a result consistent across a variety of robustness checks. (2) This poverty reduction is primarily mediated through capacity enhancement, capital accumulation, and social empowerment. (3) The RECD project promotes inclusive development, exhibiting a particularly strong poverty-reduction effect among households with lower educational attainment and in poverty-stricken areas. Furthermore, the MP alleviation impact of REC is amplified in regions where local governments prioritize rural digital development. Notably, a lack of physical capital among rural households continues to constrain the full potential of REC in addressing MP. These results contribute to the growing literature on REC and MP, offering valuable insights for developing countries seeking to reduce rural MP, improve farmer welfare, and foster sustainable development.

detail.abstract: This analytical study explores the systemic relationship between institutionalized early upbringing practices and the long-term social and economic resilience of a state. Based on professional field psychological diagnostics conducted in naturalistic environments (2020-2025) and cross-referenced with national and international data, the Psychoeconomic Resilience Model (PRM) and its operational instrument-the Psychoeconomic Resilience Index (PRI)-were developed and empirically validated. Findings indicate that consistent suppression of initiative and enforcement of submission within early educational contexts create stable behavioral and neurobiological patterns that later manifest as increased anxiety, aggression, depression, and measurable economic losses. The model provides a quantitative framework for assessing these effects and a strategic roadmap for political and corporate interventions.

detail.abstract: Background: The way we approach mental healthcare today is still mostly reactive, meaning we tend to treat psychological disorders only after they’ve fully developed. In this paper, we present Psycho-Ecological Prevention Therapy (PEPT), an innovative and proactive approach aimed at stopping these disorders before they start by using ongoing monitoring and early intervention. Methods: PEPT integrates three synergistic components: (1) “Predictive Bio-monitoring” using wearable devices and smartphone sensors to track physiological biomarkers (nocturnal Heart Rate Variability, sleep architecture, vocal analytics); (2) a “Diary of Weak Signals” (DWS) for logging micro-behavioral and cognitive precursors to distress; and (3) “Micro-Adaptive Interventions” (MAIs), which are brief, targeted exercises automatically triggered by specific deviations in the collected data. A 12-month randomized controlled trial (RCT) is proposed to verify the protocol's efficacy. Results: In a pilot study involving 50 participants, the PEPT group showed a notable decrease in the occurrence of subclinical anxiety and depressive symptoms when compared to the control group. Looking ahead to the full-scale randomized controlled trial, we expect to see a 65% drop in Major Depressive Episodes (with a Hazard Ratio of 0.35) and a 58% reduction in cases of Generalized Anxiety Disorder (Hazard Ratio of 0.42). Additionally, we anticipate significant improvements in markers of physiological resilience. Conclusion: PEPT provides a theoretically grounded and empirically testable model for shifting mental healthcare from a pathology-focused to a prevention-focused paradigm. By maintaining psychological homeostasis through ecological monitoring and micro-interventions, PEPT has the potential to establish a new standard in public mental health, offering a scalable and destigmatized approach to preserving well-being.

detail.title: Legal Regulation of Economic Security of Ukraine under the Establishment of Industry 4.0
detail.abstract:
The work examines the essence of Industry 4.0, the possibilities and advantages of introducing digital technologies into management and production processes, the risks of digitalization and threats to the economic security of Ukraine, the feasibility of improving the legal regulation of economic security in the conditions of the introduction of digital technologies is substantiated. During the analysis of legal acts, the lack of a strategic vision of ensuring economic security against the threats of digitalization, an insufficient list of security indicators for assessing the consequences of digital transformations, and the threat of Ukraine’s financial and technological dependence on developed countries were revealed. The basic principles of the formation of state policy in the field of economic security are substantiated: the rule of law, the priority of protecting economic sovereignty, the correlation and comparability of national and international legislation, adequacy, expediency, meaningfulness, rationality, timeliness and effectiveness of regulatory measures, mutually beneficial conditions of international cooperation, equality of opportunities for residents and nonresidents, stimulation of the domestic economy, sequence of opening of the national economic system for the EU economic system, priority of protection of strategic sectors of the economy, recognition of the jurisdiction of international judicial and arbitration bodies.

It is proposed to improve legal regulation in terms of expanding the principles of state policy formation in the field of economic security, revising the methodology for calculating the level of economic security of Ukraine, regulating the provisions on the development and implementation of the Strategy of Economic Security of Ukraine, establishing threats from digitalization and determining the corresponding tasks to overcome them in each sphere of economic security.

title: How has the COVID-19 pandemic brought opportunities amidst challenges for Industrial Evolution to Metropolitan Peripheral Regions？ The Case of Yangtze River Delta, China
affiliations: Tongji University, Shandong University, Tongji University and Tongji University

detail.title: How has the COVID-19 pandemic brought opportunities amidst challenges for Industrial Evolution to Metropolitan Peripheral Regions？ The Case of Yangtze River Delta, China
detail.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has reshaped regional economic landscapes. However, academic research has not yet sufficiently addressed how external investment in regions has been transformed under the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic and its influence on industrial evolution patterns. In this paper, we integrate insights from economic geography literature and develop a conceptual framework to further theorise the relationship between external shocks, changes in the industrial heterogeneity of investment from regional core cities, and local industrial dynamics. Using the COVID-19 pandemic and the Yangtze River Delta region as a case study, we employ an intensity-based Difference-in-Differences (DID) approach and draw on business registration and enterprise investment databases to estimate the impact of the pandemic shock on the evolution of local industrial dynamics between 2018 and 2024. Our findings indicate that after the core cities underwent the shock of the COVID-19 pandemic, the path dependence of industrial evolution in their surrounding areas significantly increased. The stronger the economic linkage with Shanghai, the more pronounced this effect. However, this impact also exhibits spatial heterogeneity across the Yangtze River Delta, associated with regional industrial division of labour and cooperation. This paper offers an innovative examination of how changes in the industrial heterogeneity of investment inflows from core cities—specifically, dimensions such as relatedness to local industries, industrial upgrading, and diversification—shape the mechanisms of local industrial evolution following the COVID-19 shock. Our findings offer important implications for regional development and adaptive responses in the post-pandemic era.

detail.title: How State Borders Shape the Impact of Cigarette Taxes on Prices

detail.abstract: The availability of lower-taxed goods in neighboring states incentivizes consumers to make cross-border purchases. Using transaction-level data from the NielsenIQ Consumer Panel, we analyze how proximity to a lower-tax state affects the pass-through of tax to cigarette prices. We analytically formulate tax pass-through to prices as the "true" passthrough rate attenuated by the "border effect". The "border effect" refers to the impact of cross-state purchasing behavior on the extent to which excise taxes are passed on to cigarette prices. We model the border effect as an exponential function that decreases with distance from the lower-tax state, reaching the highest value at the border itself and diminishing to zero at large distances. We estimate the parameters of the "border effect" function by employing an exponential regression model with location, time, and UPC fixed effects. The results of the robustness check, where we estimate a segmented regression using separate tax pass-through estimates for a range of distance intervals, support the linear pattern observed in the exponential model. We also extend the model to account for the tax differential between the home state and the nearest lower-tax state and perform a comparative analysis of the two model specifications. In addition to geographic variation, we also analyze how the pass-through of cigarette taxes varies across different demographic groups. High-income households face the highest tax pass-through and are largely unaffected by border proximity, while middle-income households are affected by the "border effect" only when the distance from the lower-tax state does not exceed 90 kilometers. Low-income households remain sensitive to "border effects" at greater distances, though their responsiveness declines beyond 200 kilometers. Moreover, consumers who are not engaged in paid employment exhibit significantly lower pass-through, suggesting greater scope for tax avoidance through flexible shopping behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文使用尼尔森消费者面板的交易数据，分析邻近低税州如何影响香烟税收转嫁到价格的程度。研究发现存在"边界效应"，即跨州购买行为会削弱税收转嫁，且这种效应随距离增加而减弱。不同收入群体对边界效应的敏感度不同，低收入家庭在更远距离仍保持敏感。
AI.research_question: 邻近低税州如何影响香烟税收向价格的转嫁程度？
AI.motivation: 邻近州存在税收差异会激励消费者进行跨州购买，这可能影响厂商将税收转嫁到价格的程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收转嫁理论、边界效应理论、消费者跨州购买行为理论
AI.method: 使用尼尔森消费者面板的交易数据，采用指数回归模型估计边界效应函数参数，包含位置、时间和UPC固定效应，并进行稳健性检验和分段回归分析。
AI.findings: 边界效应随距离增加而减弱；高收入家庭税收转嫁程度最高且不受边界影响；中等收入家庭在90公里内受边界效应影响；低收入家庭在200公里内仍保持敏感；无业消费者税收转嫁程度显著较低。

title: Mental Accounting and the Price of 'Free': A Critical Analysis of the Zero-Price Effect in Freemium Models and Consumer Subscription Traps

detail.title: Mental Accounting and the Price of 'Free': A Critical Analysis of the Zero-Price Effect in Freemium Models and Consumer Subscription Traps

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author, myself Harshdeep Bommareddy, declares that they have a personal relationship, as a guided student and research intern, with Professor Ramana Madupalli at Southern Illinois University Edwardsville. However, This research was conducted as an independent project.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study utilized publicly available, anonymized data, and no human subjects were directly involved. As such, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive external funding. Support in the form of access to institutional resources, guidance from faculty, and use of publicly available datasets was provided by Professor Madupalli at Southern Illinois University Edwardsville.

detail.abstract: This paper critically examines the Zero-Price Effect-a behavioral bias in which consumers irrationally prefer options that are free, even when paid alternatives offer greater overall value-and its foundational role in the rise of freemium business models and digital subscription services. Drawing on classic laboratory experiments (Ariely & Shampan'er, Shampanier et al., 2007), recent empirical studies, and real-world data from tech companies (Spotify, Dropbox, mobile gaming), this research demonstrates how "free" offerings trigger affective decision-making that overrides standard rational choice models and leads to systematic consumer errors. Through rigorous analysis of user conversion funnels, mental accounting phenomena, and sunk cost/status quo biases, the paper argues that zero-price tiers are intentionally engineered to initiate behavioral traps that increase long-run subscription conversion, reduce consumer welfare, and create market inefficiencies. The investigation further explores regulatory responses-such as the EU's crackdown on dark patterns and the US FTC's click-to-cancel mandates-and assesses their potential to mitigate exploitation. Charts and diagrams illustrate demand spikes, conversion funnels, consumer retention strategies, and regulatory timelines. Ultimately, the paper calls for a re-examination of pricing and disclosure policies in the digital economy.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析了零价格效应——消费者非理性偏好免费选项的行为偏见，及其在免费增值商业模式和数字订阅服务兴起中的基础作用。研究表明免费产品触发情感决策，导致系统性消费者错误，并探讨了监管应对措施。

AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学、零价格效应、情感决策、理性选择模型、心理账户、沉没成本偏见、现状偏见
AI.method: 分析经典实验室实验、近期实证研究、科技公司真实数据（Spotify、Dropbox、手机游戏）、用户转化漏斗、监管政策

affiliations: Charles University in Prague - CERGE-EI, a joint workplace of Charles University and the Economics Institute of the Czech Academy of Sciences

detail.title: Spatial Heterogeneity in Tax Sensitivity: Evidence from Cross-State Cigarette Purchases

publicationDetails.detailsText: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

detail.abstract: Differences in excise taxes across states incentivize consumers to make cross-border purchases. In this study, we investigate the "border effect" phenomenon, which refers to the impact of cross-state purchasing behaviors on the excise tax sensitivity of consumption. We analytically formulate the "border effect" as a linear function that decreases with distance from the closest lower-tax state. We reasonably assume that the "border effect" reaches a maximum at the border with the lower-tax state and then linearly decreases with distance from the border, eventually reaching zero after a certain cutoff distance. We estimate the parameters of the "border effect" function employing a threshold regression model with location and time fixed effects. As a robustness check, we also run a segmented regression using separate tax sensitivity estimates for a range of distance intervals. We verify that the estimates from segmented regression align with the linear pattern derived from the threshold model. Further, we enhance the "border effect" function by incorporating a difference between the home state tax and the closest lower-tax state tax as an additional factor, and then compare the estimation results for the two specifications. Beyond geographic variation, we also examine how the tax sensitivity of cigarette consumption differs across demographic groups. Our analysis shows that tax sensitivity varies by income level: high-income consumers are the least responsive to excise tax increases, while low-income consumers are the most responsive, with middle-income consumers falling in between. All income groups are influenced by the "border effect", but for high-income consumers this effect is only present at distances up to 60 kilometers from the lower-tax state. Our analysis based on employment status indicates that both employed and non-employed consumers display a similar shape in the "border effect" function; however, non-employed consumers show significantly higher tax sensitivity than employed consumers.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了跨州消费税差异引发的'边界效应'，即消费者跨境购买行为对消费税敏感性的影响。研究发现边界效应随距离降低税率州的距离线性递减，且不同收入群体对税收的敏感性存在差异：低收入群体最敏感，高收入群体最不敏感。
AI.research_question: 跨州消费税差异如何影响消费者的购买行为？具体而言，'边界效应'（即跨境购买行为对消费税敏感性的影响）如何随距离变化？
AI.motivation: 各州消费税差异为消费者提供了跨境购买的机会，这种'边界效应'可能显著影响消费税政策的有效性。理解这一现象对于制定有效的税收政策至关重要。
